description:
Designing the bridges between raw data and the stars
We are a multidisciplinary team of engineers, developers, and designers united under the banner of Orion’s Architects. Just as ancient stargazers mapped the hunter constellation to navigate the unknown, we architecture modern technology, open-source data, and creative software to solve complex challenges on Earth and across the cosmos.
summary: FarmShift is a free web app for the Field Shift challenge that helps farmers see the climate conditions at their own fields. A farmer pins a farm on an interactive satellite map by clicking the map, searching a place name, or typing coordinates. The app then pulls NASA POWER climate data for that exact location: temperature, rainfall, humidity, soil wetness (surface and root zone) and solar radiation. It shows summary numbers and charts over a chosen period and lets the farmer download the data as CSV. Farms can be saved and reloaded, and each farm can be viewed on satellite imagery, including NASA MODIS true-colour imagery from NASA GIBS. FarmShift matters because farmers planning crops for a changing climate need local rainfall, heat and soil-moisture information in a simple form, not raw datasets. It needs no login and runs in any browser.
details:
FarmShift is a lightweight, zero-login web application built with Streamlit that empowers users to pin farm locations on an interactive satellite map and analyze historical climate and weather data using the NASA POWER API. It is designed to be run locally or deployed quickly, storing farm data entirely within the current browser session with manual CSV backup options.

Core Features

  • Interactive Satellite Mapping:
    • Powered by folium and streamlit-folium.
    • Supports multiple switchable map layers including Esri World Imagery, NASA MODIS True Color imagery, OpenStreetMap, and geographical boundary overlays.
    • Click-to-pin functionality to easily record farm coordinates.
  • Global Place Search:
    • Integrated with the Open-Meteo Geocoding API to search locations worldwide and automatically populate latitude, longitude, and map views.
  • NASA POWER Climate Analytics:
    • Fetches real agro-meteorological parameters (e.g., temperatures, rainfall, root-zone and surface soil wetness, solar radiation, and relative humidity) for custom date ranges (7 to 365 days).
    • Calculates averages and totals dynamically, rendering interactive line charts and summary metric cards.
  • Session Management & CSV Persistence:
    • Maintains state locally per browser session (preloaded with a sample farm in Kottayam, Kerala).
    • Allows users to download and upload their farm datasets via CSV files for seamless portability without needing a database backend.
